blocks.text: Numbers 29 contains 40 verses. It opens with: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have a holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing of trumpets unto you. It concludes with: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that Jehovah commanded Moses. Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: The final third of Numbers prepares the new generation for land inheritance through a second census, inheritance rulings, Joshua's commission, land boundaries, towns, and tribal safeguards.
